readingOrder.rule: auto-layout: child order (absolute children after, geometric); otherwise geometric: rows by vertical overlap >= 50%, then x

segmentation.rule: top-level children by y; chrome by name leaves the body; content-less layers fold; overlapping bands merge; a single wrapper with >= 2 content bands is descended

kit.rule: a section is the outermost template-section or component instance above its nodes, else the instances inside them; one block per section (kit.mixed when several, kit.unbound when none)
